grammar.title: Originally with 本来
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 本来 + 想/是/要 + ..., 后来/但是 + 转变
grammar.explanation: 本来 (běnlái) means "originally, at first" — it sets up what someone planned or believed before things changed. It's often followed by a contrast showing what actually happened instead.

grammar.title: Formal causative with 使
grammar.pattern: A + 使 + B + 形容词/动词短语
grammar.explanation: 使 (shǐ) is a more formal, written way to say 让 or 叫 — "to make/cause someone or something to be a certain way". It's common in written Chinese, news, and essays, often followed by an adjective or a change-of-state verb rather than a concrete action.
